name: vidrush-k6
description: K6 performance testing for vidrush's internal API.

scripts.test:baseline: k6 run -e CONFIG_PROFILE=baseline --out json=reports/baseline-results.ndjson Tests/videoProjectsReadFlow.js && node custom-report-generator/generate-report.js reports/baseline-results.ndjson baseline
scripts.test:load: k6 run -e CONFIG_PROFILE=load --out json=reports/load-results.ndjson Tests/videoProjectsReadFlow.js && node custom-report-generator/generate-report.js reports/load-results.ndjson load
scripts.test:soak: k6 run -e CONFIG_PROFILE=soak --out json=reports/soak-results.ndjson Tests/videoProjectsReadFlow.js && node custom-report-generator/generate-report.js reports/soak-results.ndjson soak
scripts.test:spike: k6 run -e CONFIG_PROFILE=spike --out json=reports/spike-results.ndjson Tests/videoProjectsReadFlow.js && node custom-report-generator/generate-report.js reports/spike-results.ndjson spike
scripts.test:stress: k6 run -e CONFIG_PROFILE=stress --out json=reports/stress-results.ndjson Tests/videoProjectsReadFlow.js && node custom-report-generator/generate-report.js reports/stress-results.ndjson stress
scripts.test:baseline:full: k6 run -e CONFIG_PROFILE=baseline --out json=reports/baseline-full-results.ndjson Tests/fullReadFlow.js && node custom-report-generator/generate-report.js reports/baseline-full-results.ndjson baseline-full
scripts.test:load:full: k6 run -e CONFIG_PROFILE=load --out json=reports/load-full-results.ndjson Tests/fullReadFlow.js && node custom-report-generator/generate-report.js reports/load-full-results.ndjson load-full
scripts.test:soak:full: k6 run -e CONFIG_PROFILE=soak --out json=reports/soak-full-results.ndjson Tests/fullReadFlow.js && node custom-report-generator/generate-report.js reports/soak-full-results.ndjson soak-full
scripts.test:spike:full: k6 run -e CONFIG_PROFILE=spike --out json=reports/spike-full-results.ndjson Tests/fullReadFlow.js && node custom-report-generator/generate-report.js reports/spike-full-results.ndjson spike-full
scripts.test:stress:full: k6 run -e CONFIG_PROFILE=stress --out json=reports/stress-full-results.ndjson Tests/fullReadFlow.js && node custom-report-generator/generate-report.js reports/stress-full-results.ndjson stress-full
